eventDetail.scope: IIKI is a premier interdisciplinary forum that brings together international researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to share the latest advances and innovations in the Internet of Things (IoT), knowledge engineering, data sciences, digital economy, and related fields. IIKI has a long tradition of providing a dedicated platform for presenting cutting-edge research, fostering academic and industrial collaborations, and driving forward the theoretical and practical applications of IoT and information technologies (https://www.lait.fe.uni-lj.si/IIKI/). We invite original, high-quality research contributions from academia and industry that address foundational issues, emerging challenges, practical applications, and innovative solutions across a broad set of topics.
